## Get Wholesale Orders: offer and likely buyers

Based on the **previously fetched text supplied for two pages**, Get Wholesale Orders presents itself as a wholesale-growth agency—not simply an ordering-platform provider.

Its offer connects wholesale-channel setup, retail-buyer outreach, Faire and RangeMe management, and B2B ordering portals. The outreach page also describes targeted advertising, cold email, re-order automation and trade-show follow-up. The central purchase reason is **help building and growing a wholesale channel**, with ordering tools supporting that work. [Homepage](https://getwholesaleorders.com/) · [Outreach service](https://getwholesaleorders.com/services/ads-email-lead-gen)

### Recommended companies and decision-makers

These are **targeting recommendations inferred from the offer**, not verified facts about any individual prospect.

| Priority | Company type | Suggested decision-makers | Why they fit |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Primary** | Product brands seeking to establish wholesale distribution | Founder, owner or CEO, particularly at smaller brands | They can make the commercial decision to bring in help with channel setup and buyer outreach. [Source](https://getwholesaleorders.com/) |
| **Primary** | Brands with an existing wholesale sales function seeking additional retail opportunities | Head of Wholesale, Sales Director, VP Sales or Commercial Director | Their responsibilities connect directly to retail-buyer outreach, follow-up and re-orders. [Source](https://getwholesaleorders.com/services/ads-email-lead-gen) |
| **Secondary** | Brands seeking Faire, RangeMe or wholesale-ordering support | Marketplace Manager, E-commerce Director or Head of Operations, alongside the sales owner | Marketplace management and B2B ordering provide a relevant operational angle, though these contacts may be evaluators rather than budget owners. [Source](https://getwholesaleorders.com/) |
| **Conditional** | Brands actively considering overseas wholesale expansion | Export Director or International Sales Director | Export services support this angle, but country coverage and service scope need confirmation. [Source](https://getwholesaleorders.com/) |

**Important distinction:** retail shop owners and category managers are described as people the agency contacts **on a brand’s behalf**. They are not automatically the right prospects for buying the agency’s services.

Service-only businesses and retailers without their own product brand would generally be lower-fit starting points. The available evidence does not justify ranking particular product categories by likely performance.

**Supported introductory CTA:** a **free, no-obligation wholesale audit**. That should not become a promise of orders, buyer meetings or sales results.

### Coverage and limits

Available evidence covers only the **homepage and outreach-service page**. Live browsing is unavailable here, so other service details, industry pages, pricing, case studies and policies could not be checked. These recommendations are therefore provisional, not a completed full-site review.
